fusions.name: Flung Cinch
fusions.desc: Flings a cinch strap that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back. Your movement speed rises 10% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Trampling Drag
fusions.desc: Drags a weighted blanket round you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Stable Rug
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Well-Worn Harness
fusions.desc: Whenever you spend stamina, you regain 2 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. Your armour rises by 6%.
